title: Regime-Dependent Validity in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Evidence from SPARC Galaxy Rotation Curves and the EFC-R Framework
abstract: A pilot-scale analysis applying Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) to 20 SPARC galaxies spanning diverse morphological types, demonstrating regime-dependent validity where EFC achieves 100% success for LSB and dwarf galaxies but systematically underperforms for barred spirals. Introduces the EFC-R (Regime) framework decomposing total energy as Etotal = Eflow + Elatent to delineate EFC's domain of validity, supported by a statistically significant correlation (Spearman ρ = 0.705, p = 0.0005) between structural complexity and EFC performance.
